# Language wrappers

The wrapper targets e1 ships today. Nothing here is built from this
workspace: the list records what the dist layer owes a caller outside Rust,
in the order e1 has them.

| target       | notes                         |
| ------------ | ----------------------------- |
| c            | the ABI the rest wrap         |
| csharp       |                               |
| dart         | Flutter                       |
| go           |                               |
| kotlin       |                               |
| lua          |                               |
| node         |                               |
| python       |                               |
| react-native |                               |
| swift        |                               |
